name: 正方教务（新版 jwglxt）
author: CourseTable 内置
hint: 登录后进入「信息查询 → 学生课表查询」页面，再点击抓取。脚本会调用页面同源接口 kbcx/xskbcx_cxXsgrkb.html 获取 JSON 课表。
script: const m = location.pathname.match(/^(.*?\/jwglxt)\//); const base = (m ? m[1] : (location.pathname.split('/').slice(0,2).join('/') )) + '/'; let xnm = (document.querySelector('#xnm')||{}).value, xqm = (document.querySelector('#xqm')||{}).value; if (!xnm) { const d = new Date(), y = d.getFullYear(), mo = d.getMonth()+1; xnm = String(mo >= 8 ? y : y-1); xqm = (mo >= 2 && mo < 8) ? '12' : '3'; } const body = new URLSearchParams({ xnm: xnm, xqm: xqm, kzlx: 'ck' }); const resp = await fetch(base + 'kbcx/xskbcx_cxXsgrkb.html?gnmkdm=N2151', { method: 'POST', body: body, credentials: 'include', headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } }); if (!resp.ok) throw '接口返回 ' + resp.status + '，请确认已登录并处于教务系统页面'; const json = await resp.json(); const list = json.kbList || []; if (!list.length) throw '接口返回空课表（学年 ' + xnm + ' 学期 ' + xqm + '），请先在页面中选择学期'; return { courses: list.map(function(k){ const jc = String(k.jcs || k.jc || '').match(/(\d+)-(\d+)/); const one = String(k.jcs || k.jc || '').match(/(\d+)/); return { name: k.kcmc, teacher: k.xm || '', location: k.cdmc || '', day: parseInt(k.xqj), startPeriod: jc ? parseInt(jc[1]) : (one ? parseInt(one[1]) : 1), endPeriod: jc ? parseInt(jc[2]) : (one ? parseInt(one[1]) : 1), weekText: k.zcd || '' }; }) };
freeRoomHint: 登录教务系统后即可查询（接口 cdjy/cdjy_cxKxcdlb.html）。可按日期、节次、教室名关键字筛选。
loginCheckScript: const m = location.pathname.match(/^(.*?\/jwglxt)\//); const base = (m ? m[1] : '/jwglxt') + '/'; const r = await fetch(base + 'xtgl/index_initMenu.html', { credentials: 'include', redirect: 'follow' }); const t = await r.text(); if (/login_slogin|\/login/i.test(r.url)) return false; if (/id="yhm"|name="yhm"/.test(t) && /id="mm"|name="mm"/.test(t)) return false; return r.ok;
profileScript: const m = location.pathname.match(/^(.*?\/jwglxt)\//); const base = (m ? m[1] : '/jwglxt') + '/'; const keyMap = { '学号':'studentId', '姓名':'name', '学院':'college', '院系':'college', '专业':'major', '班级':'className', '年级':'grade', '性别':'gender', '学制':'years', '校区':'campus', '证件号码':'idNo', '手机号码':'phone', '电子邮箱':'email', '入学日期':'enrollDate', '民族':'ethnic', '政治面貌':'politics', '学籍状态':'status' }; const out = { extra: {} }; function put(k, v) { k = String(k || '').replace(/[：:\s]/g, ''); v = String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); if (!k || !v) return; const std = keyMap[k]; if (std && !out[std]) out[std] = v; else if (!std) out.extra[k] = v; } try { const r = await fetch(base + 'xsxxxggl/xsgrxxwh_cxXsgrxx.html?gnmkdm=N100801&layout=default', { credentials: 'include' }); if (r.ok && !/login_slogin/i.test(r.url)) { const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r.text(), 'text/html'); doc.querySelectorAll('.form-group').forEach(function(g){ const l = g.querySelector('label'); const v = g.querySelector('.form-control-static, p, input'); if (l && v) put(l.textContent, v.value !== undefined && v.tagName === 'INPUT' ? v.value : v.textContent); }); doc.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(function(tr){ const tds = tr.querySelectorAll('th,td'); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < tds.length; i += 2) put(tds[i].textContent, tds[i+1].textContent); }); } } catch (e) {} if (!out.name) { try { const r2 = await fetch(base + 'xtgl/index_initMenu.html', { credentials: 'include' }); const doc2 = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r2.text(), 'text/html'); const h = doc2.querySelector('.media-heading, #sessionUserName, .user-name'); if (h) out.name = h.textContent.trim(); const p = doc2.querySelector('.media-body p'); if (p) { const mm = p.textContent.match(/学号[：:]?\s*(\S+)/); if (mm) out.studentId = mm[1]; } } catch (e) {} } if (!out.name && !out.studentId) throw '未能获取个人信息，请确认已登录'; try { const pr = await fetch(base + 'xtgl/photo_cxXszp.html' + (out.studentId ? '?xh=' + encodeURIComponent(out.studentId) : ''), { credentials: 'include' }); const ct = pr.headers.get('content-type') || ''; if (pr.ok && /image/i.test(ct)) { const b = await pr.blob(); if (b.size > 500) { out.avatar = await new Promise(function(res, rej){ const fr = new FileReader(); fr.onload = function(){ res(fr.result); }; fr.onerror = rej; fr.readAsDataURL(b); }); } } } catch (e) {} return out;
